title: fix(agents): prevent unrelated tools from running during memory saving
body:
Fixes #166644

## What Problem This Solves

Hidden pre-compaction memory-saving turns can regain unrelated execution tools after their persistence-only tool set has been selected, allowing project work while a user's request waits.

## User Impact

File-backed saving retains `read` and its append-only daily-memory writer. Provider-backed saving retains `read` and the selected memory plugin's declared persistence and lookup tools. Normal foreground tooling remains available. No operator configuration or stored-state migration is required.

## Why This Change Was Made

Keep the existing memory projection authoritative through host-tool collection, MCP/LSP/client assembly, and final harness presentation. Embedded and Copilot callers forward the existing generic run trigger; supplied presentation facts cannot restore discovery or Code Mode on a memory turn.

The existing attempt contract carries the trigger, but the tool-surface factory and resolved wire presentation did not. The factory's optional generic `trigger` input preserves omitted-field source compatibility; the wire schema stays unchanged. The SDK documentation now tells harnesses to forward it, and a narrow type contract ties it to the existing attempt trigger. Selected-provider tool ownership and persistence accounting stay with their existing owners.

Maintainer cleanup shares auxiliary-tool eligibility and catalog dispatch, reducing production code by two lines against integrated main `2f71f0f03fcc531abe37530c94b70c27c247bc6e`.

Original fix by @jlapenna; maintainer cleanup by Peter Steinberger. The maintainer commit retains the contributor ancestry and includes Joe LaPenna's co-author credit. No force push or merge was performed.

## Evidence

Head: `324cd95aea2ccaded7cdf4311a0361bb67b12d38`, including a normal merge of main `2f71f0f03fcc531abe37530c94b70c27c247bc6e`. Contributor code ran only on secretless AWS lease `cbx_0e8af27b4015`, explicitly sized `r7a.xlarge` (32,135,880 kB RAM), with no hydration, IAM role, or Tailscale. The trusted main bootstrap verified the full head and isolated HOME before execution.

- **Full owner and importer suite:** 396 files passed and one platform-gated file was skipped across the 397-file selection and 19 canonical Vitest shards: **5,182 tests passed, three skipped**. This includes the four selected E2E files and the complete Copilot module. Wrapper wall time: 1,637.58 s.
- **Real Gateway before/after:** isolated state, workspace, and ephemeral ports; local mock Responses provider and an actual stdio MCP canary that appends a synthetic marker. A seed larger than 4 KiB and the existing 1 KiB transcript compaction threshold reach the real pre-compaction memory-save entry point. The daily memory nonce persisted in both variants. On the production-only main baseline, the unrelated MCP tool was offered and executed inside the hidden memory turn. On the rebuilt candidate it was neither offered nor executed, while a subsequent normal turn independently executed the same tool and returned its reply. Baseline/fixed fixture wall times: 111.45 s / 110.45 s. AWS run IDs: `run_ad0b1f96f5e22cc6023c6a6a1c95cf4e` / `run_48295eccb7c649f6ee8afbaa36880adb`.
- **Production-only negative control:** reversing only the six production-file changes, with tests unchanged, made all six memory presentation regressions fail on the restored discovery/Code Mode controls (31 unrelated cases still passed). The runner stopped after that failing shard; wall time: 36.11 s. This is separate from the passing baseline Gateway demonstration of the actual MCP side effect.
- **Types:** `pnpm tsgo:core`, affected core test graphs `agents-root`, `agents-other`, `agents-tools`, and `plugin-sdk`, plus `pnpm tsgo:extensions` and `pnpm tsgo:extensions:test` all passed.
- **SDK and static checks:** private SDK declarations regenerated canonically; API diff generated both frozen revision baselines and reported **No Plugin SDK API changes** (digest `ff7b090f`). Export and shipped-surface checks passed. No tracked generated SDK file required an update. Changed-file formatting, core and Copilot type-aware lint, docs MDX validation, and whitespace checks passed.
- **Review:** fresh independent Codex review returned scoped-clean for P0/P1/P2 on an exact-tree snapshot of the published commit. [ClawSweeper revision 8](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/166650#issuecomment-6041604734) reviewed this head with no findings or before-merge actions. Its compatibility concern is covered by the existing selected-provider ownership tests, Copilot bridge cases, optional type contract, and documentation.

The Gateway proof exercises the native file-backed path with a mock model. Provider-backed persistence and Copilot presentation are covered by owner and SDK-bridge regressions; no authenticated Copilot/provider storage run was performed on the secretless lease.

### Hosted CI disposition

[Exact-head CI run 37994340526](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/37994340526) has passing test, type, lint, and guard jobs. Its aggregate remains red for two unrelated failures:

- `build-artifacts`: stale generated `extensions/workboard/openclaw.plugin.json`. The production-only main build reproduced that drift. Main already contains [the canonical asset regeneration](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c40ca82d07a490da257e045fe7ae06f32ef320c8), whose generated pointers exactly match the AWS build; this PR does not edit Workboard.
- `docker-seed-e2e`: Docker Hub authentication endpoint timed out while pulling `alpine:3.24`, before product execution (`docker-preflight`, exit 125).

These require the coordinator's normal landing disposition; this work did not merge or bypass the aggregate. The 20 successful hosted node-test jobs consumed 2,500 runner-seconds in total, including their broader scopes and setup; that is not an estimate of incremental test cost.

### Change size and test cost

Exact `git diff --numstat` totals against the integrated main snapshot:

| Area | Added | Removed | Net |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Production | 66 | 68 | -2 |
| Tests | 208 | 8 | +200 |
| Docs | 9 | 0 | +9 |

The first five-file regression pass was 109 tests with `--maxWorkers=1`, 118.73 s wrapper wall time. Standalone measurements below use `pnpm test <file> --maxWorkers=1 --reporter=dot` with warm worker artifacts; every command passed.

| File | Tests | CLI wall time |
|---|---:|---:|
| `src/agents/agent-tools.memory-flush-writer.test.ts` | 12 | 14.52 s |
| `src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/attempt-bundle-tools.test.ts` | 48 | 13.39 s |
| `src/agents/tool-surface-plan.test.ts` | 37 | 11.69 s |
| `extensions/copilot/src/tool-bridge.host-surface.test.ts` | 8 | 16.61 s |
| `src/plugin-sdk/agent-harness-private-options.test.ts` | 4 | 14.91 s |

The complete captured memory request surfaces were exactly `[read, reliability__mark, write]` on the main baseline and `[read, write]` on the fix. The MCP append log contained one memory and three normal calls on baseline, and exactly three normal calls on the fix. Both runs wrote one designated daily-memory file.

### Commands

```sh
# All execution on the SHA-bound secretless AWS checkout after the trusted bootstrap.
pnpm test <397 owner-and-direct-importer paths> --reporter=dot
pnpm tsgo:core
pnpm tsgo:core:test --ci-graphs-json '["core-test-agents-root","core-test-agents-other","core-test-agents-tools","core-test-plugin-sdk"]'
pnpm tsgo:extensions
pnpm tsgo:extensions:test
OPENCLAW_BUILD_PRIVATE_QA=1 pnpm build
OPENCLAW_BUILD_PRIVATE_QA=1 pnpm build:plugin-sdk:dts
pnpm plugin-sdk:api:diff --base 2f71f0f03fcc531abe37530c94b70c27c247bc6e --head 324cd95aea2ccaded7cdf4311a0361bb67b12d38 --json .artifacts/rel7-checks/sdk-api.json --summary .artifacts/rel7-checks/sdk-api.md
pnpm plugin-sdk:check-exports
pnpm plugin-sdk:surface:check
node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs --tsconfig extensions/tsconfig.json extensions/copilot/src/tool-bridge.ts extensions/copilot/src/tool-bridge.host-surface.test.ts
pnpm docs:check-mdx
REL7_EXPECT_MEMORY_TOOL=present REL7_PROOF_DIR=.artifacts/rel7-live-main-retry node --import ./scripts/tsx.mjs .artifacts/live-proof.mts
REL7_PROOF_DIR=.artifacts/rel7-live-fixed node --import ./scripts/tsx.mjs .artifacts/live-proof.mts
```

Tooling failures remain distinguished from passes: the first live fixture proved a normal MCP call but did not reach optional memory maintenance; the successful fixture uses the actual preflight transcript-byte trigger and built CLI. An initial lint invocation named a nonexistent tsconfig; the corrected repository command passed. The first independent review could not write its report because the output directory was missing; the completed rerun supplied the verdict above.
